instruction: Create an ORIGINAL PURE-DART reusable package named aivexus_first_subsequence, Dart SDK >=3.3.0 <4.0.0. Implement exactly this PUBLIC TOP-LEVEL Dart function in lib/first_subsequence.dart: int findSubsequence(List<int> haystack, List<int> needle). Find the first starting position of contiguous needle inside haystack. Return -1 if not found. An empty needle returns 0 even for empty haystack. Compare signed integers exactly, do not mutate either list. Fully implement working behavior yourself, not a stub. Write reasonable tests under test/. You may use Dart core List, Map, Set, loops and standard library methods only. No third-party runtime dependencies, networking, filesystem, FFI, shell or privileged APIs. Always use valid Dart SDK APIs and compileable types. Return the strict JSON source object requested by the system prompt.
